messages:
nora: Heads up — MapleHealth invoice INV-9832 failed three times this morning, Stripe errors show card_declined + risk flag. Seen 2026-02-10 08:12 UTC. Customer is on Dedicated plan.
sam: Can you paste the error lines / txids? I'll pull the full webhook events.
nora: sure — logs below:
```
stripe_event: evt_3LxYzH2q
payment_intent: pi_1LxYyZaa
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_declined
failure_message: "Your card was declined. Please contact your card issuer."
risk_level: elevated (0.88)
last4: 4321
card_brand: Mastercard
```
jules: quick glance — issuer response contains "do_not_honor" and high risk score. This looks like an issuer-level block (BIN/IIN) rather than insufficient_funds.
billing-bot: Automated retry policy applied — schedule: attempt 1 (now), attempt 2 (+2h), attempt 3 (+24h).
nora: Customer replied to our email — treasury says they rotated cards this morning and ask for a wire instead. They want wire instructions emailed and a manual invoice.
sam: Ok I can call their treasury lead to confirm wiring details. Who owns the manual invoice in Netsuite?
jules: Finance team (nora) usually creates a one-off invoice + payment terms. Legal name on contract: "Maple Health, Inc." ACH last4 4321 (from their old card). Billing contact is treasurer@maplehealth.com.
 nora: I'll create invoice INV-9833 for $23,400 (monthly + overage) and set due date 2026-02-15. Please confirm GL code 4230 and include this memo: "Wire for INV-9833 — Redwood Inference".
payments-ops: When you're ready to collect wire, use internal manual charge flow. Example curl to record a manual wire payment (internal API):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-9833","amount_cents":2340000,"method":"wire","note":"MapleHealth treasury wire 2026-02-11"}'
```
payments-ops: After you record the payment, mark invoice status as paid and attach the wire confirmation number.
sam: I'll call the treasury lead now (on the record: call at 14:30 PT). If they confirm, we'll send wiring instructions and a signed invoice PDF.
jules: I'll open a risk case with Stripe to flag the BIN/IIN so future charges don't auto-decline. Adding Stripe case id when opened.
nora: small ask — customer asked if we can waive late fee since this looks like their card rotation. Approve a one-time waiver of the 1% late fee for this cycle?
sam: fine with waiver for goodwill. Finance: please log waiver reason and approver (sam).
billing-bot: Invoice INV-9833 created and status: pending. Retry schedule for original card charges remains active until wire recorded.
nora: Will update thread after call. tagging @sam and @jules for follow-ups. :phone: :money_with_wings:
sam: call done — treasury confirmed wire, provided ABA/Acct. I redacted details and uploaded to GCP vault. Proceeding to send wire instructions email now.
payments-ops: Once wire shows (bank reference), I'll reconcile and close the invoice. Please paste bank reference into the manual payment API call.
jules: Stripe case opened: stripe_case_20260210-01 — requested BIN unblock review.
nora: Thanks all — closing this thread once payment reconciled.
